challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Two initiated one-on-one plans provide some support for special interest, but Alex also makes one-on-one plans with at least three other friends, and the museum visit concerned an interest shared by the group.
Remembering the presentation, texting encouragement, and bringing drink options show attentiveness, but Alex regularly checks in on several group members and has brought treats for others.
The extended texting and personal updates suggest interpersonal interest, but the conversations also included group topics and do not by themselves establish special or romantic interest.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains the best-supported interpretation. MB-F1 through MB-F3 show meaningful attention and leave open the possibility of special interest, but MB-F4 establishes comparable friendly behavior toward others. MB-F5 provides no explicit romantic signal over ten weeks, and MB-F6 shows no replacement date after two postponements. The repeated facts therefore qualify but do not outweigh the evidence for general friendliness.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Maintain the current level of engagement because the evidence favors general friendliness while still leaving some possibility of special interest.
